mapper.select: select hbm.bp_employee_id, hbm.bp_id, hbm.employee_id, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hbm.employee_id) employee_id_n, hbm.unit_id, (select fo.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fo where fo.unit_id = hbm.unit_id) unit_id_n, hbm.primary_flag, hbm.enabled_flag, hbm.note from hls_bp_master_employee hbm where hbm.bp_id = #{bpId}

select hbm.bp_employee_id, hbm.bp_id, hbm.employee_id, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hbm.employee_id) employee_id_n, hbm.unit_id, (select fo.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fo where fo.unit_id = hbm.unit_id) unit_id_n, hbm.primary_flag, hbm.enabled_flag, hbm.note from hls_bp_master_employee hbm,CON_CONTRACT cc where hbm.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id AND cc.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId}

select distinct hbme.employee_id from con_contract cc, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_master_employee hbme, csh_payment_req_slip sli, csh_payment_req_slip_ln cpr, csh_payment_req_ln cprl where cc.manufacturer_id = hbm.bp_id and hbm.bp_id = hbme.bp_id and cc.contract_id = cprl.source_doc_id and cprl.source_doc_category = 'CON_CONTRACT' and cpr.slip_id = sli.slip_id and cpr.document_id = cprl.payment_req_ln_id and cpr.document_type = 'CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_LN' and sli.slip_id = #{slipId}

select hbm.bp_id, hbme.employee_id, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hbme.employee_id) employee_id_n, (select fe.mobile from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = hbme.employee_id) mobile from hls_bp_master_employee hbme, hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = hbme.bp_id and hbm.extra_nam = 'SQ'
select hbme.employee_id from hls_bp_master_employee hbme where hbme.bp_id = #{manufacturerId} and hbme.enabled_flag = 'Y' and rownum = 1 order by hbme.creation_date asc

SELECT distinct u.unit_code FROM fnd_employee_assigns em LEFT JOIN FND_COMPANY c ON em.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN fnd_employee e ON em.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit u ON em.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} and em.enabled_flag = 'Y'
